summary.headline: Infirmities and Their Causes
summary.text: Chapter 24 explains judging the native’s infirmities and their causes through the sixth sign, its lord, the part of infirmities, planets, the Moon, and the lord of the Moon’s house. Fortunes indicate health and rare illnesses, while afflicted malefics, especially in angles or succedent houses, indicate varied sicknesses; the preceding passage also discusses affection for beasts.
